svg.title: When a compile fails
svg.desc: A short flowchart for a failed compile. 1: the compile stopped or shows an error. 2: find the first error message and ignore the rest for now. 3: it names a file and a line; open that line and look just before it, too. 4: common culprits are a typo in a command, a missing closing brace or dollar sign, one of the special characters & % _ # $ typed without a backslash, or a file name or path. 5: fixed it? Compile again; if a new first error appears, go back to step 2. 6: still stuck after a fix, or the error names a tool such as latexmk or Biber instead of your file: look it up in the common messages, then ask for help. A note says your files are never changed by a failed compile.
svg.text: when a compile fails, start here
Errors are normal. Your files are
never changed by a failed compile.
